name: ChainedSimple
tagline: Verifies financial documents on a blockchain to speed up KYC between banks.

awards: Best Use of AI & Verbwire API
Most Innovative Use Of Verbwire API

problem: Verifying financial statements for KYC is slow, insecure and repeated across banks, the team saw while working at banks.
solution: Users upload documents that are verified and anchored on-chain as NFTs, with a wallet and AI checks.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a statement and share a verifiable proof.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of AI & Verbwire API” and “Most Innovative Use Of Verbwire API” among 134 submissions.
Grounded in the team's bank internships.

lessons: Industry experience makes a compliance pitch credible.
